p.espaces.cu_i3: The seller loads the goods on the ship, then the risks and costs are borne by the buyer.

p.espaces.cu_i5: The seller delivers at the destination, the buyer pays the import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: The seller pays everything, including import duties.

p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total you receive: fees + exchange rate. A price worse than the market is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose the way the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: Often an ID is required, both for sending and for receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you’ve only met online or to “unlock” a prize, a parcel, a loan or a visa: it’s almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Direct Selling means you sell a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer. Easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without approval.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale / Supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment costs and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: professional status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
